build.howGated: Flag FR13_FA2_QPAD, default OFF (FR13_FA2_QPAD_N default 64). The gate `_fr13_fa2_qpad_should_apply(tree_bias, fa_version)` returns True ONLY when os.environ FR13_FA2_QPAD=="1" AND tree_bias is not None AND fa_version==2. With the flag unset/0 it is False, so the query-pad transform block is skipped, `_fr13_qpad_unpad` stays None, and the `if _fr13_qpad_unpad is not None` un-pad at return is skipped. Runtime-verified: should_apply returns False for {flag unset}, {flag=0}, and (even with flag=1) for {tree_bias=None} and {fa_version=3}; True only for {flag=1 + tree_bias + fa2}. Because regular (non-spec) decode never carries a tree_bias, it never QPADs even with the flag ON — the verifier-only requirement is preserved. QPAD is isolated to flash_attn_interface.py; the tree_attn.py / flash_attn.py / batch_invariant.py patchers are untouched (0 QPAD refs). Env wired into the launch script default-OFF.
build.losslessRationale: Lossless-by-construction, verified bit-identical (0.0) on a kernel-faithful CPU oracle. Construction: pad the query to N_PAD_Q=64 rows (real rows at segment indices [0:M], zeros at [M:64]) AND extend the suffix-key extent by pad=N_PAD_Q-M — on the paged decode by inflating seqused_k+=pad / max_seqlen_k+=pad, on the contiguous MAB path by appending pad zero KV rows + extending cu_seqlens_k. This keeps the kernel's causal offset (max_seqlen_k - max_seqlen_q == context_len) and the tree-bias column origin (context_len) UNCHANGED from the unpadded call, so every real row's score tile is computed against exactly the same keys with the same causal limit (r+1+context_len) — only the tile OCCUPANCY (the M-dependent carrier) is now constant at 64. The padded bias [64,64] = real top-left MxM + padded diagonal 0 + everything else -inf, so real rows -inf-mask all padded/garbage keys (cols [M:64]) and padded query rows (sliced [:M]) never affect real rows. Crucially the per-(i,j) score S=q_i·k_j is computed over the fixed head dim and is invariant to key count (a CUTLASS MMA tile element does not depend on total columns) — a plain width-dependent q@k.T GEMM injects a ~6e-8 artifact the kernel does not have, which is why the oracle uses a per-column dot. Padded columns add exactly 0.0 to the softmax accumulator (IEEE x+0.0==x). The oracle confirms 0.0 real-row max_abs across M=5/9/10, B=1/3, fp32/bf16, contiguous and paged (with random garbage in the padded KV slots). RED-TEAM (carried into the doc, NOT yet settled): losslessness is verify-vs-DECODE(M=1); padding the verify to a uniform 64-tile could move it relative to the M=1 decode geometry. That is decided by GPU GATE-2 (e2e flips 22->~3), which I did not run (GPU serialized). If GATE-2 does not drop, QPAD-to-64 does not match the M=1 decode tile — that must be reported, not claimed as success.

gate.notes: NOT A SUCCESS - reporting honestly per the load-bearing red-team flag. GATE-2 is DECISIVE and it did not move (24 ~= banked 22, not native 3), and accept/event FELL below native (2.643 < 3.076). The build doc's exact red-team prediction is confirmed: QPAD makes the verify M-invariant ACROSS TREE SIZES (M9 vs M5 carrier L31 -> 0.0) but the lossless gate is verify-vs-DECODE(M=1); padding the verify to a uniform N_PAD_Q=64 tile moves the verify FARTHER from the M=1 decode geometry (BI-like), so the per-token argmax stream did NOT converge toward the M=1 decode and the flip count stayed at carrier level. CORRECTED ITERATION (do NOT pad to an arbitrary N): the QPAD target must MATCH THE M=1 DECODE TILE geometry (kBlockM/Is_even_MN/tree_bias lane offsets as the regular single-row decode realizes them), not 64. Also two secondary signals: (a) GATE-1 itself is not clean all-cells-0.0 - the L23 2-ULP residual shows even the M9-vs-M5 A/B isn't fully M-invariant under QPAD because the two arms' padded-KV layouts differ (suffix-key selection differs), so the construction's "extend suffix-key extent by pad" is not making the two arms bit-identical at every layer; (b) accept/event dropped, so QPAD also perturbs the committer's accept decisions. CONCLUSION: FR13_FA2_QPAD (pad-to-64) is NOT the fix; the carrier-localization (forked-FA2 query-tile is M-dependent, L31 1-ULP) stands and is now bit-fixable in isolation, but the deployable bar is matching the M=1 decode tile. Hygiene clean (docker empty, 106GiB avail, host recovered, git untouched at 030a1c22 on fr13-fa2-qpad; main untouched). Build is flag-gated default-OFF so nothing ships. Key files: scripts/fr13_patch_fa2_tree_bias.py (QPAD impl), output/fr13_shape_sweep/{cat9_qpad_flips.json,cat9_qpad_capture.json,qpad_gate_summary.jsonl}, output/fr13_fa2_tree_e2e/live/logs/fr13_fa2_mab.jsonl. CAVEAT on regime: this boot was EAGER (mandatory for the MAB hook, which skips during cuda-graph capture; eager is the diagnostic regime). The FA2 tile occupancy carrier is graph-capture-independent so the flip verdict holds, but a final deploy confirmation would re-measure GATE-2 on a cuda-graph-captured boot.

verdict.mergeOrIterate: DO NOT MERGE to main. This is exactly the load-bearing red-team prediction: QPAD makes the verify M-invariant ACROSS TREE SIZES (M9 vs M5 carrier L31 -> 0.0) but the lossless gate is verify-vs-DECODE(M=1); padding the verify to a uniform N_PAD_Q=64 tile moved it FARTHER from the M=1 decode geometry (BI-like), so the per-token argmax stream did not converge toward the decode and flips stayed at carrier level (24 ~= 22, not 3). ITERATE on the decode-matching path: the QPAD target must MATCH THE M=1 DECODE TILE geometry (the kBlockM / Is_even_MN / tree_bias lane offsets exactly as the regular single-row decode realizes them) - NOT an arbitrary N=64. Do NOT just retune FR13_FA2_QPAD_N; the fix is geometry-matching to the decode's M=1 tile so verify==decode for the spine row, which is the only thing the lossless gate measures. The carrier localization (forked-FA2 query-tile is M-dependent, L31 1-ULP) STANDS and is now bit-fixable in isolation. Per the FR13 policy, before declaring pad-to-decode-geometry a dead end, launch the adversarial-verify research pass first (research-before-deadend). Tree-reshape (shallower + root-sibling, the unifying lever) remains the alternative iteration that attacks the diffuse deep-accept carrier directly rather than the verify tile. NO CLOSE.
